description: Internal links and link equity. Pick with mode: suggest = Links to add, with anchors, applied by Worker or CMS. Needs audit_id. equity = Internal PageRank and click depth from a site audit. Needs audit_id.

audit_id.description: Id of a completed site audit.

important_urls.description: Optional. Pages that matter most, for example top pages by clicks or revenue.

phrases.description: Optional: phrases to turn into the link, besides the anchor text, for example natural variants.

platform.description: Optional: also return the links ready to apply: a Cloudflare Worker that links the first mention on each page, a WordPress edit plan, or the edits for the code.

topic.description: Topic or main keyword of the target page.

name: internal_links
title: Internal links
